title: A divided continent
goal: I can summarise how the Cold War divided Latin America, contrasting how things were with what has changed.
grammar: the imperfect vs the present perfect for change over time

items: I can say who was divided in Latin American societies.
I can say how countries differed in their policy towards Cuba.
I can say what historians discuss today.
I can contrast what was the case with what has changed.
I can contrast how things were with what has changed, using the imperfect and the present perfect.
I can say how the Cold War divided universities, unions and churches.
I can say how Mexico differed from other countries over Cuba.
I can say what historians discuss about the causes of the conflicts.
I can say what the new archives have allowed historians to do.
